change: Opt-in --shape-choice-replays N: failure-only replay of early legal shape/side choices, including combinations. Round-robin alternative rank prevents a shape-rich early block from consuming the frontier before later decisions get an alternative. Initial-seat hints do not become permanent restrictions during later eviction/repair.
budget: N is additional full packing attempts per attempt_pack call, not per board build. Root attempt is additional to N. Queue capacity is limited to remaining executions; discarded/unexplored prefixes produce an explicit budget event on failure. Successful original attempts are retained without replay.

accounting.classification: Search effort, not hardware waiver. Record replay before execution; keep every failed attempt's accounting through restoration and exceptions.

tests.status: All five PASS against final production code; subsequently expanded retry tests also PASS.
coverage: Successful incumbent and complete receipts unchanged.
Previously failing fixed-order packing fixture recovered with one replay; independent same-face overlap/bounds and repeatability checks.
Two binary choices with impossible final block execute all four combinations, including combined changes.
Every aggregate quantization count and fallback event equals a sum of separately executed observed prefixes; independent scalar observer also agrees.
Budget cutoff, caller restrictions, rollback of layout/offers/hints/borrowed trace, exception propagation and interrupted-work accounting.
Shape-rich first decision does not starve the next decision's first alternative.
Impossible enforced hardware separation still rejected by composition with resolved pad geometry.
CLI and profiler reject invalid configuration and integer limits. New events explicitly registered and audited.

review.scope: Read-only bounded review of replay state, rollback, accounting and caller restrictions.
review.result: No concrete bugs found. First-pass-only trace is a search-coverage limitation, not proof of infeasibility.
